g.text: 3.3 V push-pull / open collector encoder only; add source pull-ups

g.desc: 3.3 V push-pull / open collector encoder only; add source pull-ups

g.text: for open collector. RC nominal 100 ns; selected as an educational

g.desc: for open collector. RC nominal 100 ns; selected as an educational

g.text: short-cable interface. Clamp diodes provide limited surge protection.

g.desc: short-cable interface. Clamp diodes provide limited surge protection.

g.text: Cable ESD / EMC, hysteresis and edge timing need physical verification.

g.desc: Cable ESD / EMC, hysteresis and edge timing need physical verification.

g.text: MCU is external; signal directions in electronics documentation.

g.desc: MCU is external; signal directions in electronics documentation.

g.text: GPIO must have Schmitt inputs on ENC_* and LIMIT_N.

g.desc: GPIO must have Schmitt inputs on ENC_* and LIMIT_N.

g.text: 3.3 V supply is an output: do not back-power this interface.

g.desc: 3.3 V supply is an output: do not back-power this interface.

g.text: Drive must accept 3.3 V STEP/DIR and active-high ENABLE.

g.desc: Drive must accept 3.3 V STEP/DIR and active-high ENABLE.

g.text: FAULT is 3.3 V open drain. No motor voltage/current on board.

g.desc: FAULT is 3.3 V open drain. No motor voltage/current on board.

g.text: ENABLE default low. A firmware fault must lower ENABLE.

g.desc: ENABLE default low. A firmware fault must lower ENABLE.

g.text: NC switch closed: LIMIT_N ~0.30 V; open/broken wire: high.

g.desc: NC switch closed: LIMIT_N ~0.30 V; open/broken wire: high.

g.text: Nominal release RC 1 ms; closure RC 91 us. Debounce in MCU.

g.desc: Nominal release RC 1 ms; closure RC 91 us. Debounce in MCU.

g.text: E-STOP AUX is monitoring only. An independent safety relay

g.desc: E-STOP AUX is monitoring only. An independent safety relay

g.text: must interrupt drive STO / actuator energy outside this board.

g.desc: must interrupt drive STO / actuator energy outside this board.

g.text: 5.0 V +/-5% regulated source. 3.3 V total load budget <=150 mA.

g.desc: 5.0 V +/-5% regulated source. 3.3 V total load budget <=150 mA.

g.text: PWR_FLAG: external source / diode-passive source declaration.

g.desc: PWR_FLAG: external source / diode-passive source declaration.

g.text: C1/C2 X7R; effective output capacitance >=1 uF after DC bias.

g.desc: C1/C2 X7R; effective output capacitance >=1 uF after DC bias.

g.text: R14/R15 DNP by default: LTC2850 has internal receiver failsafe.

g.desc: R14/R15 DNP by default: LTC2850 has internal receiver failsafe.

g.text: Optional bias at one node only. JP1 closed only at two bus ends.

g.desc: Optional bias at one node only. JP1 closed only at two bus ends.

g.text: 250 kbit/s target; non-isolated short bench bus; common ground.

g.desc: 250 kbit/s target; non-isolated short bench bus; common ground.

g.text: Six joint nodes + gripper node; bus firmware remains conceptual.

g.desc: Six joint nodes + gripper node; bus firmware remains conceptual.
